search.d9d1e324dc: Configure DeepSeek usage tracking with an API key. DeepSeek publishes only the account balance, not usage or cost history.
search.d3b18e19e2: Configure Fireworks.ai usage tracking with an API key and an optional account ID override.

section.53ce175669: Configure DeepSeek usage tracking for your account.
section.e60b2e635a: Stored locally in the Orca encrypted credential store and sent to DeepSeek only to refresh your balance.
section.0c4385003d: Paste the API key from your DeepSeek platform account for local balance fetching.
section.27efc84bc7: Create a key in your DeepSeek platform account and paste it here. The DeepSeek API exposes only the current balance — there is no usage or cost history to show — and the balance may be denominated in CNY or USD depending on the account.

section.5f31aaba69: Configure Fireworks.ai usage tracking for your account.
section.56669b1597: Stored locally in the Orca encrypted credential store and sent to Fireworks.ai only to refresh your rated spend.
section.5e8948033a: Paste the API key from your Fireworks.ai account for local spend fetching.
section.fd8437b974: Create a key in your Fireworks.ai account and paste it here. Orca refreshes rated spend for the current billing period, in US dollars.
section.c1c89f3dac: Optional account ID override for keys that can see more than one Fireworks.ai account.
section.d74a913846: Orca discovers the account ID from your API key. Set an override only when the key can see multiple accounts; leave it blank to keep auto-detection. Saving with the API key field blank keeps your stored key, and Forget key clears the account ID as well.

section.fa8def1ab4: Optional. Required only when using an enterprise billing token override.
section.4d5c01e15c: Optional. Paste a GitHub token that can read enterprise billing and the slug it belongs to.
section.259e2dff8e: Stored locally in the Orca encrypted credential store and sent to GitHub only to refresh your Copilot AI-credit usage.
section.ed307672cd: Configure GitHub Copilot usage tracking for your account.
section.233569347b: Orca reads Copilot usage with your GitHub CLI sign-in. Nothing is saved in Orca.
section.f1c1fd4ffb: Run this to finish setting up the GitHub CLI for your Copilot entitlement:
section.022c7c89d5: Orca reads your Copilot AI-credit entitlement through your GitHub CLI sign-in, which needs the user scope. Paste a token only for an enterprise billing override. The token needs the “Enterprise billing” read permission. Orca then refreshes the AI credits available to you each month.
section.1006eed696: The slug is the <slug> in github.com/enterprises/<slug>.
section.3c8314c1de: Saving with the token field blank keeps your stored token, so the slug can be edited on its own. Forget token clears the slug as well.
